boundary: zero model, GPU or network contact. Every number is computed from outputs JSONL files two separately registered runs already sealed; gold enters only through the registered scorers

replication_outcome_vs_paper.rule: PASS = per-tier official tool accuracy within 5 pp of the paper row on tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6 with the tier rank order preserved; CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE = the paper value inside the tier's Wilson CI90 (n = 50) on all four but at least one outside 5 pp; FAIL = neither. These are the official-protocol replication preregistration's own definitions, cited by name in the Q8 preregistration's decision rule

decision.consequence: No outcome changes the operating core by itself, tunes any knob, or opens any test data. Whether Q8_0 with expert offload becomes the Audio2Tool operating core is a separate owner decision informed by the throughput recorded here.
decision.rule: QUANTIZATION-DOMINANT: the pooled Q8-minus-Q4 tool-accuracy CI90 lower bound over the four acceptance tiers (1, 2, 5, 6) is above 0 AND C-q8 is PASS or CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE against the paper on those tiers. QUANTIZATION-EXCLUDED: the pooled CI90 includes 0. PARTIAL: otherwise (preregistration section 6)

paired_basis.delta: right minus left, i.e. C-q8 minus R-official-raw
paired_basis.same_rows: the identical frozen 400, one contact each, same gold, same scorer
paired_basis.stratification: tier for the tier blocks, domain for the domain blocks
